use_cases: Creating engaging text reveal animations for hero headlines that capture user attention
Displaying loading or processing states with animated placeholder text
Adding visual interest to password input masking and unmasking effects
Enhancing data display elements with dynamic text transformation effects
Building interactive text-based components in educational or media applications
ai_summary: A text animation utility component that creates a character scrambling effect, progressively revealing text by replacing characters with random symbols before displaying the final message. Built on motion/react for smooth transitions, it supports customizable duration, speed, character sets, and trigger control. Ideal for creating engaging text reveals in hero sections, loading states, or interactive UI elements across SaaS, media, and creator platforms.
